## Checklist

- [ ] I've read the [developer guide](https://bedrockrelay.com/developers.html) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] `plugin.json` matches `plugin.js` (`id` and `version`), and `version` is raised for an update.
- [ ] It declares `privacy` if it reveals anything about players.
- [ ] Any screenshots show the plugin as it really looks, with no personal details or other people's names visible unless they agreed.
- [ ] No network access, and no reading server secrets or variables.
